assignment.fit: Breyer's own Cobb and causal-inquiry commitments support a practical separation of the charged-offense violation, later waiver, actual exploitation and the resulting trial remedy. His frozen proof-standard position accepts preponderance on interview-sequence facts while distinguishing Wade's identification-reconstruction problem, which is precisely the new legal work. O'Connor, through her Elstad work and actual acceptance of this separate constitutional inquiry, is the strongest alternative at four leads. Stone-Zsela's approved causal formulation is also a complete fit at four, but Breyer can express that supported objective with three counted leads and no loss of qualification. The Scalia-Thomas objection cannot be removed by a writer's choice, so it remains a substantive partial concurrence rather than an invented expansion join.

audit: Nine votes support reversal and remand and the initial violation. Seven directly support causal independence, the government's preponderance burden and conditional exclusion/Chapman/new-trial instructions. Scalia and Thomas join the initial violation and judgment but withhold the later-statement rule; their published partial concurrence supplies the actual waiver-centered ground. The proof supplement was independently modeled and reconciled before assembly. The defendant's initial violation-and-causal-nexus showing is distinct from the government's specified quantum. The Chief's approved position supports all seven-member portions and the complete mandate without fallback.
screen: All earlier completed public decisions in this chunk through Freier were screened. Lidster resolves checkpoint reasonableness and preserves separate later-investigation grounds; it does not replace Massiah's charged-offense rule. Trinko's civil antitrust causation and equity requirements supply no criminal suppression quantum. The other sale, regulatory, civil-access, decree, timing and ballot holdings change no premise here. Same-date Lamie supplies no entering law.
